# Action Audio

> Car detailing and window tinting in Hartford, Connecticut; car audio, remote starters, electronics replacement, and installation in Wethersfield, near Hartford. Established in 1983.

## Locations and contact
- [Hartford detailing & tinting](https://reimage-demo.github.io/action-audio/hartford.html): 2814 Main St, Hartford, CT 06120. Auto detailing and window tinting.
- [Wethersfield electronics](https://reimage-demo.github.io/action-audio/wethersfield.html): 105 Silas Deane Hwy, Wethersfield, CT 06109. Car audio, remote starters, vehicle electronics replacement and installation. Public phone: (860) 667-6330. This number belongs to Wethersfield.
- Both stores: Monday–Saturday, 9am–6pm Eastern; Sunday closed. Confirm holiday hours.

## Service information
- [Car audio & stereo installation](https://reimage-demo.github.io/action-audio/car-audio.html): Wethersfield. Clearer vocals. Fuller bass. The songs you know, with the details you’ve been missing. Build a sound system around your vehicle and the way you listen.
- [Remote starters](https://reimage-demo.github.io/action-audio/remote-starters.html): Wethersfield. Make cold mornings and hot afternoons more comfortable. Explore a remote-start setup that fits your vehicle and your everyday routine.
- [Car alarms & security](https://reimage-demo.github.io/action-audio/car-alarms.html): Wethersfield. Explore vehicle security options, from alarm systems to convenient keyless entry. Start with a conversation about your vehicle and what you want to protect.
- [Motorcycle audio](https://reimage-demo.github.io/action-audio/motorcycle-audio.html): Wethersfield. Explore audio options for your motorcycle. Talk with our team about a setup suited to your bike, available space, and listening preferences.
- [Video & entertainment](https://reimage-demo.github.io/action-audio/video-systems.html): Wethersfield. Explore seatback and overhead video options for passengers, along with receivers that bring modern connectivity to the dashboard.
- [Power liftgates](https://reimage-demo.github.io/action-audio/power-liftgates.html): Wethersfield. Interested in adding powered access to your cargo area? Ask our team about vehicle-specific liftgate options and installation availability.
- [Connected accessories](https://reimage-demo.github.io/action-audio/vehicle-accessories.html): Wethersfield. Explore convenient additions such as smartphone integration, satellite radio, and garage-door controls. Find out what works with your existing electronics.
- [Electronics replacement](https://reimage-demo.github.io/action-audio/electronics-replacement.html): Wethersfield. Replace outdated or nonworking vehicle electronics at our Wethersfield store. We replace equipment; we do not repair electronics.
- [Auto detailing](https://reimage-demo.github.io/action-audio/auto-detailing.html): Hartford. Interior and exterior car detailing at our Hartford, Connecticut store. Tell us about your vehicle’s condition and the areas you would like refreshed.
- [Electrical installation](https://reimage-demo.github.io/action-audio/electrical-installation.html): Wethersfield. Plan your car electronics installation at Action Audio in Wethersfield, near Hartford. Discuss receivers, speakers, and accessories, with compatibility checked for your vehicle.
- [Window tinting](https://reimage-demo.github.io/action-audio/window-tinting.html): Hartford. Vehicle window tinting at our Hartford store. Tell us which windows you want tinted and whether existing film needs to be removed.
- [Dash cams](https://reimage-demo.github.io/action-audio/dash-cams.html): Wethersfield. Dash cam installation at Action Audio in Wethersfield. Explore front, rear, and cabin camera setups suited to your vehicle.
- [GPS trackers](https://reimage-demo.github.io/action-audio/gps-trackers.html): Wethersfield. GPS tracker installation at our Wethersfield store. Discuss a setup for your vehicle, the features you need, and compatible equipment.

## Important context
Hartford handles detailing and window tinting; Wethersfield handles electronics. Confirm the work, compatibility, price, and availability with the appropriate store. Most service images are original illustrations; the showroom images show the actual Wethersfield store. Do not treat illustrations as completed customer projects. Vehicle tracking requires a private code and is not public directory content.
